name: Wildebeest
description: Wildebeest and hartebeest are large antelopes of Africa's grasslands, herbivore Mammals with high, heavy shoulders, a back that slopes down to the rump, and a long face.$(br2)They live in herds that follow the rains in search of fresh grass, and are the main prey of lions, hyenas and wild dogs.$(br2)During the Pleistocene, a giant relative roamed southern Africa.
